candidate.title: Disqus importer drops original topic/OP created_at by switching to TopicEmbed.import_remote without forwarding created_at
reports: [advisory] the rewritten disqus import replaces postcreator.new(..., createdat: date.parse(t[:createdat]), category: categoryid) with topicembed.importremote, whose opts only forwards :title and whose topicembed.import path never accepts or forwards createdat. every disqus thread re-imported with this task is timestamped 'now' — the chronological order of the migrated forum is destroyed (all topics sort as brand-new and original posting dates are unrecoverable), and the previously supported :category option was dropped with no replacement.

[bug] the rewritten import replaces postcreator.new(..., createdat: date.parse(t[:createdat]), category: categoryid) with topicembed.importremote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title]), dropping the original thread timestamp for the first post. imported op posts carry the import-run timestamp while the unchanged reply loop keeps original disqus dates, producing topics whose first post is dated after its replies and destroying the chronological fidelity the importer existed to preserve; the post body also changes from a permalink pointer to a full remote-page scrape with no acceptance of that content change.
